<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market sentiment and crude impact:</strong> Indian indices are poised for a weak start as GIFT Nifty signals a decline, driven by Brent crude prices breaching the $92 mark and ongoing Middle East geopolitical tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and capital flows:</strong> The Indian rupee faces renewed downward pressure from the oil surge, potentially offsetting the positive sentiment from recent FII net buying of ₹1,650 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory update:</strong> SEBI has eased distributor rules for SIFs, allowing new certifications that permit the sale of mutual fund products.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Energy and commodity volatility:</strong> Crude oil has hit a two-month high amid escalating US-Iran tensions, while gold prices have climbed to a two-week high as investors seek safe-haven assets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Macroeconomic headwinds:</strong> Rising crude prices and persistent US rate-hike expectations are dampening prospects for a rupee rebound and threatening to push the currency toward record lows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxPTXA3MERlWm9YcmNHUTg2NDBBT0JFb3I1RllrRGJ5U3dvVGxPRUN0R2VPdjE0SF9IMVlncHZhMVlYQTBSQTY1RUE5M2YySkpsd2xpbUQ3S2RuX1l3cFlPSDU1T2Mxdy1semJDR2ZFcjlXejdpbU1GYS1BZXFYcDNiVmNEbnRxaFdrN1BPaU0weWtPa3RadVpkbmxFXzdGdUJPS09QVEdhemlqeVRFTVpOU2dBUVVZbm1ta3NUX3NfSnc0UQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
